scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix web-admin ci && npm --prefix mobile-app ci
scripts.sync:shared: rm -rf mobile-app/src/shared web-admin/lib/shared && cp -R backend/src/shared mobile-app/src/shared && cp -R backend/src/shared web-admin/lib/shared
scripts.check:shared: diff -r backend/src/shared mobile-app/src/shared && diff -r backend/src/shared web-admin/lib/shared
